title: 経営分析
subtitle: Business Analysis
keywords: Corporate database such as EDINET 2.Industry analysis 3.Profitability analysis 4.Safety analysis 5.Cash flow analysis
educationalGoal: This course corresponds to the “Financial Accounting Ability” learning/education goal of the Faculty of Management Information. In order for managers to fulfill their duties in the future, analytical information on management activities is required. In this course, students will acquire the knowledge and skills necessary for management analysis and develop the ability to make comprehensive judgments on the results of management analysis from a multifaceted perspective.
advice: In the first half of the course, students will learn how to collect and organize information centered on the use of EDINET, etc. In the second half, students will practice management analysis using various analytical methods based on information collected and organized for specific companies. Finally, students will prepare and submit a management analysis report and give a presentation on the results of their management analysis. When doing the assigned exercises, it is important that students pay attention to economic news and company information and study in depth their target company and industry.
books: Textbook: Not specified Reference book: Not specified Reserved Book: Not specified
requiredKnowledge: Students will need to thoroughly review what they learned in Basics of Corporate Accounting before taking this course.

activityGoals.body: Be able to understand that management analysis information is useful for making decisions.
Be able to collect and organize corporate information through EDINET, HP, and other media.
Be able to understand basic ratio analysis formulas and use them in specific management analysis exercises.
Be able to a conduct business analysis of a given company and clearly present ideas and findings.

achievementLevels.ideal: ・ Be able to recognize that management analysis information is useful for managers and interested parties, and understand what information users are looking for. ・ Be able to use EDINET and HP to collect company and industry information and analyze industry characteristics and SWOT analyses of specific companies. ・ Be able to analyze the financial status of specific companies using accounting-related knowledge and management analysis formulas. ・ Be able to summarize the results of management analysis in reports, and create PPT materials based on objective materials.
achievementLevels.standard: ・ Be able to understand that management analysis results are useful for managers and interested parties. ・ Be able to use EDINET and HP to collect company and industry information. ・ Be able to calculate management index values for specific companies using basic management analysis formulas. ・ Be able to summarize the results of management analysis in reports and give appropriate presentations.
